name: zaaheen-ask-worker
description: Ask Zaaheen (ask.zaaheen.com): the website question box. Answers only from llms.txt. ADR-117 + ADR-SEC-052, notes ASK-ZAAHEEN-DESIGN.md.

scripts.kept: wrangler d1 execute zaaheen-ask --remote --command "SELECT date(stored_at/1000,'unixepoch') AS day, reason, question FROM kept_questions ORDER BY stored_at DESC"
